index.title: AI-gile: hoʻo kautaha AI faʻu polokalama, ʻi he laupapa pe taha
index.description: Ko e AI-gile ko ha laupapa kanban ia maʻa e ngaahi kautaha AI ʻoku nau tohi koti. ʻOku nau ngāue lolotonga hoʻo mohe; te ke maʻu ha fanga kiʻi haʻanga nounou ʻo e ngaahi meʻa ke ke fili, sivi mo tali.
hero.h1.html: Hoʻo kautaha AI faʻu polokalama, ʻi he laupapa pe taha.
hero.alphaTitle: ʻOku teʻeki ke kakato: mālō hoʻo feinga!
hero.lede: ʻOku nau faʻu lolotonga hoʻo mohe. Te ke ʻā ʻo maʻu ha haʻanga nounou pe taha: ngaahi fehuʻi siʻi, ngaahi meʻa siʻi ke sivi, mo ha taimane violeti ʻe taha pe ua. Lomiʻi, fakamoʻoni, pea foki ki hoʻo kofi.
hero.secondary: Agile, ka ʻoku ʻikai fiemaʻu ʻe he kautaha ha kofi stand-up. (ʻOku nau fai pē stand-up.)
pitch.h2: AI-gile ʻi he ngaahi lea ʻe lahi ʻaki hoʻo loto
pitch.lede: Fili ha lōloa, mei he lea pe taha ki he 144. ʻOku taki taha ʻa e lōloa ko ha fakamatala makehe, naʻe tohi maʻa e lahi ko iá. Toho e slider pe ngāueʻaki e ngaahi kī ngahau.

pre.title: AI-gile: ʻoku langa ha meʻa
pre.description: ʻOku langa ha meʻa ʻi heni: ko ha laupapa ʻoku langa ai ʻe he ngaahi timi AI ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ke kole, pea nau ako atu kiate koe ʻi he lolotonga. Ko ha pre-alpha tāpuni mo e ngaahi kaungāmeʻa ki he taimí ni.
pre.h1: ʻOku langa ha meʻa ʻi heni. 🤫
pre.line: Ko ha laupapa ʻoku langa ai ʻe he ngaahi timi AI ʻa e meʻa ʻoku ke kole, pea nau ako atu kiate koe ʻi he lolotonga. Ko ha pre-alpha tāpuni mo e ngaahi kaungāmeʻa ki he taimí ni.
pre.peek: ʻI mui ʻi he sioʻata: ko e laupapa moʻoni, moʻui. Ko e kaati kotoa ko ha laine lanu.
pre.peekFake: ʻI mui ʻi he sioʻata: ko e fōtunga ʻo ha laupapa ʻoku ngāue.
features.aria: Ko e meʻa ʻoku ne fai
f.pile.html: Ko e Maʻau ʻoku ne tauhi ʻa e meʻa kotoa ʻoku tatali kiate koe, ʻi he poloseki kotoa: ngaahi fehuʻi, ngaahi meʻa ke sivi, ngaahi ngāue ʻoku faʻa fai pē ʻe ha tokotaha. ʻOku fakahā ʻe hoʻo laine ʻa e meʻa hokó mo e taimi ʻe fie maʻu.
f.sleep.h: Ngaahi kautaha ʻoku ngāue lolotonga hoʻo mohe
f.sleep.p: Ko e poloseki kotoa pē ʻoku ʻi ai ha taki mo ha kautaha ʻo e ngaahi ʻeiseniti AI. Fai ha fakamatala ʻi ha kaati pea ʻe ʻā ʻa e kautaha, fai e ngāue, pea ʻoatu ia mo e ngaahi sitepu ʻe lava ke muimui ai ha tokotaha ongosia.
f.tester.h: ʻOku vakai ʻuluaki ʻe ha tokotaha sivi AI
f.tester.p: Ki muʻa ke aʻu ha meʻa kiate koe, ʻoku muimui ʻa e tokotaha sivi ʻi he ngaahi sitepu ʻi ha kopi ʻo e polokalama pea fakahā ʻa e meʻa naʻá ne sio ki ai, mo ha screenshot. Lau fakavave ʻa e ngaahi meʻa kuo pasi pea fakamoʻoni ʻaki ha lomiʻi pe taha.
f.proof.h: Fakamoʻoni, ʻikai ko e ngaahi talaʻofa
f.proof.p: Ko e tuku atu kotoa ʻoku fakahā ai ʻa e meʻa kuo liliu: ngaahi faile, kehekehe, mo e ngaahi screenshot. ʻIkai fiemaʻu ke fakaava ʻa e polokalama kotoa ke sio pe kuo kakato.
f.chat.p: Ko ha kolomu hangē ko e Discord: ko e fakaʻilonga pe taha ki he poloseki taki taha, taimane violeti maʻa e meʻa ʻoku fiemaʻu ai koe. Fekau ha fakakaukau ki ha taki; te ne liliu ia ki he ngaahi kaati mo ha palani, mo ha pātani ✅ Fai.
f.tidy.h: ʻOku tauhi ʻe ia ʻa ia ke lelei
f.tidy.p: Ko e ngaahi kaati fekauʻaki ʻoku fakataha ʻo hoko ko e taha, ko e ngaahi hingoa hala ʻoku fakatonutonu, pea ʻoku tauhi ʻe ha vakai token ʻa e koti ke maʻamaʻa. Siʻi ange ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ke fetongi, siʻi ange ʻa e fakakaukau.
f.private.h: Ko hoʻo meʻa, ʻi hoʻo komipiuta
f.private.li1: ʻOku ngāue ʻa e laupapa ʻi hoʻo komipiuta pea tali pē kiate koe.
f.private.li2: Ko e ngaahi pōpoaki fakapulipuli ʻo e kakai ʻoku fakapulipuliʻi mei he ʻuluaki ki he ngataʻanga (end-to-end).
f.private.li3: ʻIkai ha akauni, ʻikai ha toʻo fakaʻilonga, ʻikai ha kuki.
f.lang.p: Lea ʻe laka hake he 120, mei he lea faka-Hōlani, faka-Uēlesi mo faka-Siapani ki he kaihaʻa tahi, Yoda mo e Klingon, mo ha fetongi vave ki he lea fakapālangi maʻa e ngaahi lea makehe.
f.service.h: Mei ha fakakaukau ki ha sēvesi moʻoni
f.service.p: Kuo ke langa ha meʻa ʻaki ʻa e AI ʻoku ngāueʻaki he taimi ni ʻe he kakai? Fakaʻilongaʻi ia ko ha sēvesi pea ʻe tokoni ʻa e laupapa ke ke lele lelei ia: vakai uptime, peesi tuʻunga ki he kakai, ngaahi meʻa fakatuʻupakē mo ha lipooti, ngaahi liliu ʻoku fiemaʻu ha GO, ngaahi tatau tauhi ʻoku vakaiʻi fakaʻaho. ʻOku akoʻi ʻe he Tokoni ʻa e sitepu taki taha lolotonga hoʻo ngāue.
msgr.h2: AI-gile Messenger: ko hoʻo timi ʻi ho kato
msgr.p1: Talanoa mo hoʻo timi AI taʻe fakaava ʻa e laupapa. Talanoa mo hoʻo kau taki poloseki mo ho ngaahi kaungāmeʻa, pea sio ki he ngaahi sitepu sivi ʻo ha kaati pea tali ia, kotoa mei hoʻo telefoni.
msgr.p2: Ke fakahoko, sikeni ha QR code ʻi hoʻo laupapa. ʻUluaki taimi? ʻE fakahā atu ʻe ha talanoa fakatātā fakakaumeʻa ʻa e meʻa kotoa.
msgr.when: Android ʻuluaki, pea hoko ai ha paaki uepi ki he telefoni mo e iPhone.
msgr.b1: Kuo mateuteu ʻa e fakatonutonu ʻo e dark mode. ʻOku ke fie maʻu ʻa e ngaahi sitepu sivi?
msgr.b3: 1. Fakaava ʻa e Settings. 2. Fili ʻa e Dark. ʻOku sai hono fōtunga?
tl.aria: Laine ʻo e taimi mei he talanoa ʻuluaki ki he palani
tl.h2: Mei he talanoa ʻuluaki ki he meʻa hoko mai
tl.lede: Ngaahi ʻaho mo e taimi moʻoni, ʻi hoʻo feituʻu taimi. Hili e ʻahó ni ko e palani pē ia, ʻikai ha ʻaho kuo talaʻofa.
join.lede: ʻOku faʻu ʻa e AI-gile ʻe ha tangata kehe ʻoku ʻi ai hono kava, mo e AuDHD pea mo ha ngaahi tau mo e moʻui lelei ʻa e ʻatamai, mo ha ngaahi ʻeiseniti kātaki lahi. ʻOku fakapulipuli he taimi ni, ʻi ha alpha tāpuni mo e ngaahi kaungāmeʻa. Te ke loto ke ke feinga ʻo ka ava?
join.small: Te mau imeili atu, ʻikai ha toe meʻa

privacy.title: AI-gile: meʻa ʻoku mau tauhi
privacy.lede: Fakanounou: ko e meʻa pē ʻokú ke fekau mai, pea ʻikai fuoloa.
privacy.only: Ko e meʻa pē ʻokú ke fekau mai: ko e meʻa ʻokú ke tohi ʻi ha foomu, hangē ko hoʻo imeilí. ʻIkai ha toe meʻa kehe fekauʻaki mo koe.
privacy.sealed: ʻOku silaʻi ia koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa lava ʻe homau sēvá ʻo lau: ʻi hoʻo browser kimuʻa pea ʻalu (ʻi ha browser motuʻa, ʻi he taimi pē ʻoku aʻu mai ai). Ko homau laupapá pē ʻe lava ʻo fakaava ia.
privacy.server: ʻOku holoki ia mei he sēvá ʻi he taimi pē ʻoku aʻu ai ki homau laupapá. Ko ha meʻa ʻoku kei ʻi ai hili ha ʻaho ʻe 30 ʻoku holoki pē ia.
privacy.board: ʻOku mau tauhi ia ʻi homau laupapá kae ʻoua kuo mau tali atu kiate koe, pea mau toki holoki foki ia ʻi ai.
privacy.none: ʻIkai ha toʻo fakaʻilonga, ʻikai ha kuki, ʻikai ha fakatotolo fakafika.
privacy.local: Ko hoʻo leá mo hoʻo fili ʻo e maama pe fakapoʻulí ʻoku nofo pē ʻi hoʻo browser. ʻOku ʻikai teitei fekau mai ia kiate kimautolu.
privacy.ask: Fie holoki vave ange? Tali mai ki heʻemau imeilí ʻo tala mai.
